# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and System Information

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" as the application name.
- **System Date and Time**: Shows "Oct 23 02:00" centered in the title bar.
- **System Notification Icon**: A bell icon is visible next to the date and time.
- **Window Control Buttons**: Located at the top-right corner, including minimize, maximize, and close buttons.
- **Desktop Environment Indicator**: "Activities" is visible at the top-left, indicating the GNOME desktop environment.

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: "File", "Edit", "Selection", "View", "Go", "Run", "Terminal", "Help" are listed from left to right.
- **Active Menu**: The "File" menu is highlighted with a blue underline, indicating it is currently selected or hovered over.

## Left Sidebar (Explorer Panel)

- **Panel Title**: "EXPLORER" is displayed at the top of the sidebar.
- **Folder Structure**:
  - **USER Directory**: Expanded, showing subdirectories and files.
    - Subdirectories: `.cache`, `.config`, `.gnupg`, `.ipython`, `.local`, `.mozilla`, `.pki`, `.ssh`, `.thunderbird`, `.var`, `.vscode`, `Desktop`, `Documents`, `Downloads`, `Music`, `Pictures`, `project`, `Public`, `server`, `snap`, `Templates`, `Videos`.
    - Files: `.bash_history`, `.bash_logout`, `.bashrc`, `.lesshst`, `.profile`, `.selected_editor`, `.sudo_as_admin_successful`, `.viminfo`, `requirement.txt`.
  - **Folder Icons**: Each folder is prefixed with a folder icon, and files are prefixed with a file icon.
  - **Expand/Collapse Arrows**: Each folder has a right-pointing arrow indicating it can be expanded or collapsed.
- **Sidebar Icons**:
  - **File Explorer Icon**: A folder icon at the top of the sidebar.
  - **Search Icon**: A magnifying glass icon.
  - **Source Control Icon**: A branching icon.
  - **Debug Icon**: A bug icon.
  - **Extensions Icon**: A square grid icon.
  - **Terminal Icon**: A terminal icon.
  - **Settings Icon**: A gear icon.
  - **User Icon**: A person icon.
  - **Grid Icon**: A 3x3 grid icon at the bottom-left, likely for application launcher.

## Main Content Area

- **Welcome Tab**: The "Welcome" tab is active, indicated by a blue "X" icon next to the tab title.
- **Welcome Page Content**:
  - **Title**: "Visual Studio Code" in large font.
  - **Subtitle**: "Editing evolved" in smaller font.
  - **Start Section**:
    - **New File...**: An icon of a document with a plus sign.
    - **Open File...**: An icon of a document with an arrow.
    - **Open Folder...**: An icon of a folder with an arrow.
    - **Connect to...**: An icon of a cloud with an arrow.
  - **Recent Section**:
    - **Recent Files**: "project" is listed with a small arrow indicating more options.
- **Walkthroughs Section**:
  - **Walkthrough Title**: "Walkthroughs" is displayed.
  - **Walkthrough Cards**:
    - **First Card**: "Started with VS Code" with a description: "Organize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding".
    - **Second Card**: "The Fundamentals" with a description: "Learn the fundamentals".

## Trust Dialog Box

- **Dialog Title**: "Do you trust the authors of the files in this folder?"
- **Icon**: A blue shield icon with a keyhole.
- **Description Text**:
  - "Code provides features that may automatically execute files in this folder."
  - "If you don't trust the authors of these files, we recommend to continue in restricted mode as the files may be malicious. See our docs to learn more."
  - Path: "/home/user"
- **Checkbox**:
  - "Trust the authors of all files in the parent folder 'home'" with an unchecked checkbox.
- **Action Buttons**:
  - **No, I don't trust the authors**: A gray button with the text "Browse folder in restricted mode".
  - **Yes, I trust the authors**: A blue button with the text "Trust folder and enable all features".

## Bottom Panel

- **Status Bar**:
  - **Settings Icon**: A gear icon with a number "1" indicating there is one setting available.
  - **Outline and Timeline**: "OUTLINE" and "TIMELINE" are listed with expand/collapse arrows.
  - **Status Indicators**: Three icons indicating zero errors, warnings, and information
